fee_waiver.value: The university says it cannot offer application fee waivers.

gre_general.value: The graduate school says to check each program's page for whether the GRE is required, so the rule is set per program.
gre_general.quote: Visit our programs page to determine if the GRE is required for the graduate program to which you are applying

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum of 79 on the 0-120 scale (4.5 on the 1-6 scale).
toefl_min.quote: A satisfactory score of 79 or higher on the TOEFL iBT (0-120 scale)

ielts_min.quote: IELTS: A satisfactory score (6.5 or higher) is required

english_waiver.value: India is not on the list of countries whose English-medium degrees waive the test, so Indian applicants must submit a score.
english_waiver.quote: Only applicants who hold a baccalaureate or graduate degree, with primary instruction in English, from an accredited institution in one of the following locations are not required to demonstrate English language proficiency

notes: Doctoral programs at UL Lafayette (graduate school list): Applied Computing and Information Sciences, Applied Language and Speech Sciences, Biology Environmental & Evolutionary, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Earth & Energy Sciences, Education Ed.D., English, Francophone Studies, Mathematics, Nursing Practice DNP, Systems Engineering. Only the STEM ones are saved as program records. Systems Engineering PhD has no matching field in data/fields.json and is not saved. Conflict: the doctoral list says 'No GRE Required' for Biology, Computer Engineering and Mathematics, while the program pages list official GRE scores (Biology, Computer Engineering) or say GRE scores are optional (Mathematics). The program pages are used. Funding uses the graduate-assistantships page, which applies to all programs.
